story_type: lone sailor in 30-foot seas and 70-knot wind far offshore, expired beacon registration, helicopter hoist
hook: One man, one sailboat, thirty foot seas, 145 miles out.
narration: One man on a sailboat, one hundred forty five miles off Alaska, in thirty foot seas and seventy knot winds.
At three p.m., his emergency beacon went off. Its registration said the boat had been sold, and its batteries were low.
Watchstanders called the previous owner. He said the new owner planned to sail from Seward to the Philippines.
A beacon sends its position by satellite, and the registration tells rescuers whose boat it is and who to call.
A Jayhawk crew from Air Station Sitka reached him at five twenty one p.m.
outcome: The crew hoisted him from his sailboat and flew him to Yakutat, where local EMS met them.
title: Sailing to the Philippines in 30 ft seas
description:
An Air Station Sitka MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoists a man from his disabled 33-foot sailboat in 30-foot seas and 70-knot winds about 145 nautical miles west of Sitka, Alaska, on Oct. 11, 2021.

facts.claim: Disabled vessel about 145 nautical miles west of Sitka, Oct. 11, 2021
facts.source_quote: The Coast Guard rescued a man from a disabled vessel approximately 145 nautical miles west of Sitka, Alaska, October 11, 2021.
On scene weather conditions were: Overcast at 400ft, Winds – 70 knots, Seas – 30 feet

facts.claim: Beacon alert at 3 p.m.; registration showed sold, expired, low batteries
facts.source_quote: Seventeenth District watchstanders received an alert from the survivors’ emergency position indicating radio beacon at 3:00 p.m. The EPIRB registration information indicated the vessel was sold, had an expired registration, and indicated the batteries were low.

facts.claim: Previous owner said new owner planned Seward to the Philippines
facts.source_quote: Watchstanders contacted the previous vessel owner who reported the new owner intended to leave his homeport in Seward, Alaska and travel to the Philippines with possibility of going to Seattle beforehand.

facts.claim: Arrived 5:21 p.m., hoisted him from the 33-foot sailboat, flew him to Yakutat
facts.source_quote: A Coast Guard Air Station Sitka MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew arrived on scene at 5:21 p.m. and hoisted a man from his 33-foot sailing vessel, Ananda, and transported him to Yakutat, where they were met by local EMS.
